newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Group in venture with China group.
newsitem.headline: Royal Group in venture with China group.

text.p: Royal Group Technologies Ltd said on Thursday that it reached an agreement with China National Real Estate Development Group (CRED), the real estate arm of the Chinese government, to build houses in China.
Royal said the agreement will create a joint venture 10 percent owned by China National, 54 percent owned by Royal Group and 36 percent owned by Shanghai Land Corp, subject to regulatory approval.
Royal said the approval process should be determined prior to May 31, 1997.
Royal said in January that a business license had been granted to its joint venture Shanghai Royal Building Systems Ltd to manufacture and distribute the Royal Housing System in China.
"CRED will help us build upon the solid foundation we have created in China," said Vic De Zen, Royal Group's chairman, president and chief executive officer.
Royal Group is an extruder of vinyl building products and its building technologies group manufactures and distributes a polymer-based building system, known as the Royal Building System.
Its joint venture Shanghai Royal is nearing completion of a 150,000 square foot manufacturing plant in the Songjiang Industrial Zone.
